16.en: Heresies of all kinds have wracked the Macharian Sector, but it is no stranger to turbulent times. In the wake of disaster, the great machine of the Imperium will dust off the corpses and do its best to pick up where it left off. Holy Terra demands its tithe, and those in power will see it delivered once more.

22.en: The outcome of your Heresies Macharia campaign and the fate of its Inquisitors will no doubt differ from any other. The following are some examples of where aspects of the campaign may lead, including some plots and intrigues left lingering in the wake of yet another sector-wide upheaval.

30.en: bears the burden of getting the Inquisition back on track. There are no doubt seats to fill, power vacuums to tend to, and stringent cells and resources across the sector to bring back into the fold. The Macharian Inquisition is indeed in a weakened state, and it will take the efforts of its most esteemed Inquisitor to build it back up.

34.en: Aspects of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol} remain active across the sector. The remaining Inquisitors must decide whether to investigate its protocols further and wield it as the weapon

38.en: intended it to be or dismantle and deprogram its components so that they may never be used again. Regardless of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek}’s fate, she contacted her peers in Segmentum Solar. These agents of the Adeptus Terra may take an interest in finishing what she considered a viable option — combining the @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Herald’s Howl} and @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocols} to sacrifice the Macharian Sector in the name of Holy Terra, buying time against Hive Fleet Leviathan.

42.en: The last remnants of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} have gone into hiding. @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists} are accustomed to playing a long game; many seek new spaces to spend generations rebuilding their hidden armies. Though characters are likely to see a decrease in Genestealer Cult activity across the sector, plentiful cells still need rooting out — they are a threat that should not be forgotten.

46.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} may be defeated or on the run, but the results of his @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.UAWh0hEvWDwob6CT]{Isstvanian} plotting are yet to come to fruition — what of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} craftworld he once sought to draw into the sector to spark conflict.

50.en: Would a wounded Imperium be able to come out on top against such a powerful alien foe? What secrets has @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} uncovered that could aid the Inquisition in cleaning up his mess?

54.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud}’s obsession with the heretic @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#machariuss-generals]{General Cyrus} — that he still somehow lives and plots from the shadows — may warrant further investigation. What pieces she has gathered indicate a plot more secretive and existentially dangerous to the Imperium, yet just as widespread and troublesome as the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}.

62.en: The outcome of the Heresies Macharia may leave many issues in the sector unresolved that characters can pick up and continue to investigate, especially those relating to their Patron’s Philosophy. What remains of their Inquisitor’s plans that they can fulfil? With many threats quelled across the sector, now may be the perfect time for their Patron to make their move.

66.en: Consider the options available in @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.SJPyRkdBEOCtmD8R]{Sector Threats} and advice in @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK]{Running Inquisition Adventures} to build brand new sector-spanning missions and campaigns. Now may be the chance for characters to focus on a new threat, one better fitting their Ordo’s mission.

70.en: Your characters' actions in the Heresies Macharia may have elevated them to a higher position in their Patron’s retinue. This improved position comes with greater responsibility and autonomy — they will be expected to solve more problems without their Patron’s oversight and utilising their own accumulated resources. For completing the campaign, consider granting them their own prominent base of operations or personal voidship to traverse the sector and continue their adventures.

74.en: Finally, keep an eye out for future

78.en: supplements. More thrilling adventures and ways to play the game are coming for Inquisition characters and those from other Factions.
